text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: I didn’t think I’d have to deal with a slime that could melt clothes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
服を溶かすスライムが相手とは……

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I don't even have a coliseum anymore
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで、
コロシアイどころじゃ
なくなっちゃいましたよー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Hehehe~ Misora. Looks like we have no choice but to cooperate for now, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ～
ミソラちゃん。
今は協力するしかなさそーだね？

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text: Guess there's no helping it. Let's beat him and have a coliseum! ★
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないですねー
ちゃちゃっと倒して、
コロシアイしますか★

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
一時休戦だね～♪

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, I'm hesitant to defeat him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それはそれで、
倒すのを
躊躇してしまうのですが……
